name: Background
description: A full-frame background: one colour, or a linear gradient from color to `to`. Colours are theme tokens (bg, fg, accent) or CSS colours. Put it on the main track (a title card) or a free video track under the text.
author: Uncut

color.description: The colour (or the gradient's first colour): a theme token or a CSS colour.

to.description: Makes it a linear gradient from color to this colour.

angle.description: The gradient's direction in degrees, CSS-style (180 = top to bottom, the default).
